chapter_title_en: The Heavens Tremble, A Core is Born
chapter_seo_title: Han Li's 60-Year Seclusion Ends with a World-Shaking Core Formation | RMJI Ch.403
chapter_meta_description: After sixty years of solitary cultivation, Han Li emerges as a Core Formation master. His experiment with the Gold Devourer Beetles and the strange Rainbow Skirt Grass takes an unexpected turn. The heavens split as a new powerhouse is born in Heaven Star City.
og_title: The Sky Splits! Han Li Finally Forms His Golden Core
og_description: Han Li’s sixty-year gamble pays off in a world-shattering breakthrough. But first, he discovers a terrifying secret about his Gold Devourer Beetles.
twitter_title: After sixty long years, Han Li becomes a Core Formation master. The cultivation world just got a new heavyweight.
twitter_description: Han Li completes his sixty-year seclusion and triggers a massive heaven phenomenon, shocking all of Heaven Star City. Plus, he learns his Gold Devourer Beetles have a taste for Rainbow Skirt Grass.

lore_anchors.definition: The second major realm of cultivation, where a cultivator crystallizes their liquid qi into a solid Golden Core within their dantian, granting vastly increased lifespan and power. It is marked by a visible heaven phenomenon.
A type of spirit herb whose name references the rainbow-colored celestial garments of Daoist immortals. Its leaves emit a unique aura that is highly attractive to demon beasts, especially when aged.
A legendary, high-ranking strange insect (#73 on the Imperial Spirit Sect’s list), prized for its nigh-indestructible shell and ability to consume almost any material.
A unique cultivation technique that requires the user to deliberately lower their cultivation and rebuild it multiple times, greatly compressing their qi for a vastly more powerful foundation.
The dangerous, deep-sea frontier region of the Starfall Sea, home to high-grade demon beasts and few safe havens.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Why did Han Li waste sixty years cultivating when he could hunt for resources?
cultural_notes_faq.a: The later stages of cultivation require immense amounts of internal refinement and bottleneck-breaking, which cannot be skipped by simply acquiring wealth. The sixty years were necessary to safely absorb the massive stockpile of demon core energy and break through the core formation barrier.

cultural_notes_faq.q: What was the point of feeding the Rainbow Skirt Grass to the Gold Devourer Beetles?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Han Li was trying to understand the grass’s mysterious attracting aura for demon beasts. The dormant beetles ignored it at first, but when he used fresh accelerated grass with a stronger aura, they swarmed it. This suggests the grass’s effect on sensitive, high-grade insects is related to the concentration of a specific, fleeting scent or energy.

cultural_notes_faq.q: Is the "Heaven Phenomenon" at the end dangerous?
cultural_notes_faq.a: Not for Han Li—it’s a sign of success. However, it makes him highly visible. Every Core Formation cultivator in Heaven Star City now knows a new power player has emerged, which can attract both allies and unwanted rivals.
